# LinkShift

> LinkShift is a URL shortener for people who care about every click: precise
> short links on your own domain, matching QR codes, and per-link click
> analytics. The Free plan includes 100 links, 10 QR codes and
> 5 custom slugs a month; paid plans add custom domains, a longer
> analytics window, CSV export and bulk import.

Public site: https://linkshift.in

## Product

- [LinkShift — URL Shortener with QR Codes & Link Analytics](https://linkshift.in/): LinkShift turns long URLs into precise short links. Every code ships with QR, custom domains, and analytics that show where every click comes from.
- [Pricing](https://linkshift.in/pricing): Start free, move up when your links earn it. Every limit is written down — nothing hidden behind a sales call. Plans from Free to Pro.
- [FAQ](https://linkshift.in/faq): The short version of everything. Answers to common questions about LinkShift links, QR codes, domains, analytics, billing, and account security.
- [Service Status](https://linkshift.in/status): Live availability for LinkShift redirects, link storage and analytics. If a short link is not resolving, check this page first.
- [Campaign Short Links with UTM Tracking](https://linkshift.in/campaign-links): Save utm_source, medium and campaign on a short link once. LinkShift builds the destination with them, and reports human clicks per campaign with referrer and country.
- [QR Code Studio — Styled Codes on Your Own Domain](https://linkshift.in/qr-codes): Design a QR code for any LinkShift link: colour, pattern, corner style, logo and frame. Change the destination later and the printed code still opens the new page.
- [Move URLs to Your Own Domain](https://linkshift.in/url-migration): Move a site or client site to your own domain. Import the URL list your crawler or CMS already produced, and keep every destination editable.

## Documentation

Index: https://linkshift.in/docs

Getting started:
- [Create your account](https://linkshift.in/docs/create-your-account): Sign up with email or Google, verify your address, land on your desk.
- [Shorten your first link](https://linkshift.in/docs/shorten-your-first-link): Paste a destination, get a short code, share it anywhere.
- [Read your dashboard](https://linkshift.in/docs/reading-your-dashboard): What the Overview and Analytics instruments actually mean.

Links & routing:
- [Manage and protect links](https://linkshift.in/docs/managing-links): Edit destinations, set expiry, and password-protect a route.
- [Tags](https://linkshift.in/docs/tags): Group links by campaign and filter the ledger down to one.
- [Social link preview](https://linkshift.in/docs/social-link-preview): Control how a shared link looks in Slack, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and X.
- [Redirect tester](https://linkshift.in/docs/redirect-tester): See where a link would actually send someone, per platform.
- [Custom slugs](https://linkshift.in/docs/custom-slugs): Readable codes like /spring-sale instead of generated ones.
- [Path & query forwarding](https://linkshift.in/docs/path-forwarding): One short link that carries whatever path and query a visitor appends through to your destination. URL forwarding — not app opening.
- [Mobile app deep linking](https://linkshift.in/docs/mobile-app-deep-linking): Try to open your mobile app when a visitor arrives on a phone — with a website or store fallback when it isn't installed.

Custom domains:
- [Add and verify a domain](https://linkshift.in/docs/add-a-domain): Point a CNAME at LinkShift and verify ownership.
- [Choose your default domain](https://linkshift.in/docs/default-domain): Which hostname new links are created on.

QR codes:
- [Design a QR in the studio](https://linkshift.in/docs/qr-studio): Colors, corners, embedded logo, and live preview.
- [QR allowances](https://linkshift.in/docs/qr-limits): How many codes you can generate per month on each plan.

Analytics & data:
- [Metrics, defined](https://linkshift.in/docs/metrics-defined): Exactly what each instrument measures.
- [Analytics history & ranges](https://linkshift.in/docs/history-and-ranges): 30 days to 3 years, enforced per plan.
- [Export CSV](https://linkshift.in/docs/csv-export): Take a link's analytics out of LinkShift — Creator and above.
- [What we record on a click](https://linkshift.in/docs/what-we-record): The exact signals behind your analytics, and the IP address we don't keep.

Billing & plans:
- [Plans & limits](https://linkshift.in/docs/plans-and-limits): The full limit table, in plain words.
- [Upgrades, downgrades & payments](https://linkshift.in/docs/upgrades-and-payments): Payments run through Razorpay; changes prorate at the next cycle.

Account & security:
- [Profile & sign-in](https://linkshift.in/docs/profile-and-sign-in): Name, avatar, password and Google sign-in.
- [Delete your account](https://linkshift.in/docs/delete-your-account): What deletion removes, and what keeps working until then.

Troubleshooting:
- [App won't open from a link](https://linkshift.in/docs/app-wont-open): A checklist for deep links that show the interstitial or the website instead of your app.
- [Paths or queries not arriving](https://linkshift.in/docs/paths-not-arriving): The appended tail disappears between your short link and the destination.
- [Domain verification failing](https://linkshift.in/docs/domain-verification-failing): The CNAME is set but LinkShift still says unverified.

## Account

- [Log in](https://linkshift.in/login): Sign in to your LinkShift account and pick up where your links left off.
- [Create your account](https://linkshift.in/register): Sign up for LinkShift and get your first short link in thirty seconds. Free plan, no card required.

## Company & policies

- [Contact](https://linkshift.in/contact): How to reach the humans behind LinkShift — support, billing, privacy and abuse reports.
- [Privacy Policy](https://linkshift.in/privacy): What LinkShift collects, why, and how long we keep it. Written for the product as it actually works.
- [Terms of Service](https://linkshift.in/terms): The agreement between you and LinkShift for using the service. Short, readable, and enforceable.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://linkshift.in/refunds): How cancellation, refunds and failed international payments work for LinkShift subscriptions.
- [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://linkshift.in/shipping): LinkShift is a fully digital service — there is nothing to ship. This policy states what is delivered, how, and when delivery is complete.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://linkshift.in/acceptable-use): The line between a short-link tool and an abuse tool. Links that cross it are removed.

LinkShift is operated as a sole proprietorship from Dehradun, Uttarakhand,
India. The default shared short-link domain is go.linkshift.in; short links on
that domain redirect visitors — they are not documentation pages.
